Whether you’re pitching a potential client, running an all-hands meeting, or demoing a new product, a great presentation means telling a great story. That’s why [we launched Slides in beta last year](https://www.figma.com/blog/introducing-figma-slides/)

—as a tool that brings all the design power of Figma into a friendly interface the whole team can use. Today, we’re thrilled to announce that you can now extend those capabilities with plugins, just as you’ve been doing in Figma and FigJam.

Some of your favorite plugins—and some exciting new ones—are already compatible with Slides. From eye-catching images, to color gradient controls, to animation, these plugins make it easier to tailor your designs and build a compelling narrative. To get you started, we’ve rounded up some stand-out plugins to try at every stage of slide creation.

## [Populating your slides](#populating-your-slides)

### [Pull ready-to-use graphics with IconScout](#pull-ready-to-use-graphics-with-iconscout)

When you’re deep in the flow of building your deck, the last thing you want to do is hunt for graphics to bring your ideas to life. Luckily, [IconScout](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/744098704933821409/iconscout-icons-illustrations-3d-assets-lottie-animations-unicons) puts millions of high-quality icons, illustrations, Lottie animations, and Unicons at your fingertips. Tweak your designs with a custom color palette, or find similar assets with reverse image search.

[![An illustration of a person searching for icons through a telescope](data:image/png;base64,)![An illustration of a person searching for icons through a telescope](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/b79753b21750010d2b1cd45a8e5b60ffd467573c-3400x1921.png?w=3400&h=1921&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/744098704933821409/iconscout-icons-illustrations-3d-assets-lottie-animations-unicons)

[**Try IconScout**](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/744098704933821409/iconscout-icons-illustrations-3d-assets-lottie-animations-unicons) to access a library of illustrations, icons, and Lottie animations.

### [Ditch boring backgrounds with Mesh Gradient](#ditch-boring-backgrounds-with-mesh-gradient)

Create custom backdrops and color fills that feel tailored to your brand with [Mesh Gradient](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/958202093377483021/mesh-gradient), which allows you to edit the vertices and edges of an underlying grid. Get live previews of each gradient, and save and upload them for further editing.

[![A cover image shows a pink, purple, and orange mesh gradient](data:image/png;base64,)![A cover image shows a pink, purple, and orange mesh gradient](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/2d5ac313c9c9b08844184bd741b7bb504b42c700-1920x960.png?w=1920&h=960&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/958202093377483021/mesh-gradient)

### [Turn PDFs into assets with PDF.to.design](#turn-pdfs-into-assets-with-pdf-to-design)

If you find yourself wrestling with a PDF, look no further than [this plugin](https://pdf.to.design/), which imports the file as designs with editable layers so you can extract the text and images you need. Plus, files are kept private on your local machine, so you don’t have to worry about revealingsensitive information.

[![A cover image shows a PDF from a book being imported into Figma](data:image/png;base64,)![A cover image shows a PDF from a book being imported into Figma](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/eb0f93c946b3701f643eeac66a04a63f303feb3a-1920x1080.png?w=1920&h=1080&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1280917768965269588/pdf-to-design-by-divriots-import-any-pdf-to-figma)

## [Adding power and polish](#adding-power-and-polish)

### [Animate your designs with Jitter](#animate-your-designs-with-jitter)

It’s a well known fact that motion draws the eye. Import individual slides or your entire deck into [Jitter](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/961270034818256057/jitter-animation-for-figma) to easily animate text and images, and choose from a variety of effect parameters for fine-grained control over how individual elements behave.

[![Two screenshots show a purple Jitter screen on top of a Figma canvas.](data:image/png;base64,)![Two screenshots show a purple Jitter screen on top of a Figma canvas.](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/a196e1f333006d9f3fc07962dfd528e8787dde63-1920x1080.png?w=1920&h=1080&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/961270034818256057/jitter-animation-for-figma)

### [Connect to your audience with UI Faces](#connect-to-your-audience-with-ui-faces)

Whether you’re presenting user research or sharing a design mockup, avatars humanize your work and help you and your teams relate to your audience. Choose from a library of AI-generated faces ranging from photorealistic, to cartoonish, to abstract, to hand-drawn—to the downright outlandish with [UI Faces](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/769664006254845172/ui-faces-free-ai-avatars)’ alien set.

[![A grid of faces overlaid with "1000+ free avatars"](data:image/jpeg;base64,)![A grid of faces overlaid with "1000+ free avatars"](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/0e9360f145cd99696aab22a7f609f3ce60c444e9-1920x1080.jpg?w=1920&h=1080&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/769664006254845172/ui-faces-free-ai-avatars)

### [Match your slides to music with BeatSync Video Maker](#match-your-slides-to-music-with-beatsync-video)

There’s nothing quite like a video set to a catchy beat to keep your audience engaged. With [BeatSync Video Maker](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1408882187583522762/beatsync-video-maker), you can upload a track—or choose a provided tune—and select slides to match up to the automatically parsed beats. Export the video for a hype reel that’s ready to share, or upload it to another presentation as a compelling closer.

[![A screenshot shows slides being stitched together in a video](data:image/png;base64,)![A screenshot shows slides being stitched together in a video](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/1727b61866cbd328947eb2330f57a1d697d0a40b-1920x1080.png?w=1920&h=1080&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1408882187583522762/beatsync-video-maker)

## [Preparing to present](#preparing-to-present)

### [Tidy up your design with Clean Deck](#tidy-up-your-design-with-clean-deck)

Things can get messy when you’re building a deck, and that’s a good thing—moving sections around in grid view, cutting unnecessary slides, and throwing assets onto the canvas for easy reference are all part of telling a compelling story. When you’re ready to present or publish a new template, however, it’s time to clear the clutter. [Clean Deck](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1469706571453254985/clean-deck) scrubs skipped slides and off-slide layers so you don’t have to do the dirty work yourself.

[![Before and after screenshots shows hidden slides disappearing from grid view](data:image/png;base64,)![Before and after screenshots shows hidden slides disappearing from grid view](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/a7415eb8820dcec890599632b815756e3c038881-1920x960.png?w=1920&h=960&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1469706571453254985/clean-deck)

### [Get your timing down with Rehearse](#get-your-timing-down-with-rehearse)

It’s always a good idea to do a couple dry runs before giving a big presentation. Whether you’re running the show or [sharing the spotlight with other presenters](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/24260248467735-Spotlight-yourself-or-other-presenters#h_01J0Y1CNASB03EGH62N89MZMZZ), [Rehearse](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1468318667786408715/rehearse) keeps track of how long you spend on each slide as well as total elapsed time. With practice, you’ll hit your beats and stay on pace.

[![A screenshot shows timestamps on past slides](data:image/png;base64,)![A screenshot shows timestamps on past slides](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/fe6dd5d2f84b03d396a0b7eb65668570e7213232-2880x1620.png?w=2880&h=1620&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1468318667786408715/rehearse)
